fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.qtype_zh: 端午习俗（粽子/龙舟/艾草/五彩绳）

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: Xintiandi is known for old ____ houses mixed with modern shops.
questions.q_zh: 新天地以旧____和现代店铺在一起出名。
questions.explain_en: Shikumen are stone-gated Shanghai houses kept in Xintiandi.
questions.explain_zh: 新天地保留了石库门，又有现代店铺。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 45 sachets are put equally into 3 boxes. How many in each box?
questions.q_zh: 45 只香囊平均放进 3 个盒子，每盒几只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 18 mugwort bundles are hung equally on 3 stall doors. How many bundles per door?
questions.q_zh: 18 束艾草平均挂在 3 个摊位门口，每家几束？

questions.subject: duanwu
questions.q_en: A sachet worn at this festival is usually filled with ____.
questions.q_zh: 过这个节戴的香囊，里面通常装着____。
questions.explain_en: Sachets hold fragrant herbs such as mugwort.
questions.explain_zh: 香囊里装着艾草等香草。
questions.qtype_zh: 端午习俗（粽子/龙舟/艾草/五彩绳）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 72 mugwort bundles are hung equally on 9 stall doors. How many bundles per door?
questions.q_zh: 72 束艾草平均挂在 9 个摊位门口，每家几束？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 49 mugwort bundles are hung equally on 7 stall doors. How many bundles per door?
questions.q_zh: 49 束艾草平均挂在 7 个摊位门口，每家几束？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: There are 15 stall doors on the street, and 2/5 of them have mugwort hung up. How many doors have mugwort?
questions.q_zh: 这条街上有 15 个摊位门口，其中 2/5 挂了艾草，有多少家挂了艾草？

questions.subject: duanwu
questions.q_en: The doorman at Xintiandi says the warm parcel in the leaf wrapper is made mainly of ____.
questions.q_zh: 新天地的礼宾说，这只热乎乎、用叶子包着的食物，主要是用____做的。
questions.explain_en: Zongzi are made mainly of glutinous rice wrapped in leaves.
questions.explain_zh: 粽子主要是用叶子包的糯米。

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: On Huaihai Road under the plane trees, the light turns red as Flora rides her e-bike. What should she do?
questions.q_zh: 淮海路梧桐树下，Flora 骑着电动车时灯变红了。她应该怎么做？
choices: Ride on the sidewalk at full speed
Close her eyes and keep going
Race through as fast as she can
questions.explain_en: A red light means stop, even on an e-bike.
questions.explain_zh: 红灯要停，骑电动车也一样。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A welcome mat at the Xintiandi door is 10 m long and 7 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口的迎宾地毯长 10 米、宽 7 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the Bund, 8 dragon boats each carry 7 paddlers, and 4 drummers sit on the shore. How many people is that in all?
questions.q_zh: 外滩有 8 条龙舟，每条有 7 名桨手，岸上还有 4 名鼓手，一共多少人？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Bund, 60 race flags are shared equally by 5 dragon-boat teams. How many does each team get?
questions.q_zh: 在外滩，60 面比赛旗平均分给 5 支龙舟队，每队几面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 20 zongzi sit on the trays at Xintiandi, and 1/2 of them are sweet bean. How many zongzi are sweet bean?
questions.q_zh: 新天地托盘上有 20 只粽子，其中 1/2 是豆沙馅，豆沙粽有多少只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A gift box of zongzi at Xintiandi is 16 cm × 13 cm × 10 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.q_zh: 新天地一个粽子礼盒长 16 厘米、宽 13 厘米、高 10 厘米，体积是多少立方厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Near Xintiandi, Flora buys 3 zongzi at 6 yuan each and pays with 30 yuan. How much change does she get?
questions.q_zh: 在新天地附近，Flora 买了 3 只粽子，每只 6 元，付了 30 元，应找回多少元？
